Design Guidelines


Accessibility GuideLearn about accessibility requirements that apply to multifamily housing.

Active DesignLearn about active design guidelines for creating healtheir buildings, streets, and spaces.

Affordable HousingLearn about a new coordinated review process and some of the best recent affordable housing built.

BroadbandLearn about the different types of residential internet service (broadband) and the agency's guidelines for installing internet service.

Design Guidelines for Repairs and Maintenance Review minimum design standards that ensure repairs and maintenance projects can meet NYC's ambitious climate, resiliency, health and safety goals.

LL30 Universal Design FeaturesLearn about universal design features required in new construction developments with 41 or more units.

Local Law 97 Guidance for Affordable HousingLearn about requirements of Local Law 97 for affordable and rent-regulated housing.

Specifications for Rehabilitation ProjectsLearn about specifications for those performing work on HPD-assisted rehabilitation projects.

New Construction Design GuidelinesReview guidelines for multifamily new construction and senior housing.

Passive HouseLearn about Passive House standards and HPD's featured Passive House projects.

Preservation Design GuidelinesReview minimum design standards that ensure all HPD projects can meet NYC's ambitious climate, resiliency, health, and safety goals.

ResiliencyStay up-to-date with changes to the Flood Insurance Rate Maps and related requirements.

Retail DesignFind practical recommendations for building functional, accessible, convenient, and cost-effective ground-floor retail space.

SustainabilityExplore the agency's featured high performance projects, sustainbility initiatives, and more.
